directions.name: O — Hand-modelled clay
directions.style: RENDERING O: genuine playful stop-motion CLAY sculptures. Soft plump rounded volumes, slightly squashed handmade proportions, visible tiny fingertip dents, subtle clay tool marks and matte nonreflective surfaces. All six subjects should unmistakably be sculpted from coloured clay including the string and page marks as slender clay coils. Imperfect edges, warm tactile miniature craft, restrained soft contact shadows on white, gentle large studio light upper left. Natural material details, no glossy plastic, no polished airbrushing, no wood, no ceramic glaze. Keep silhouettes and arrangement from the master. The depth and irregularity must be obvious.

directions.name: P — Soft vinyl
directions.style: RENDERING P: bold contemporary soft-vinyl 3D illustration. Smooth inflated slightly bouncy shapes, broad rounded bevels, seamless satin plastic, soft translucent-looking highlight edges without actual glass transparency. Clean bright specular highlights and soft ambient occlusion. More inflated and polished than clay, absolutely NO fingerprints, grain, fibres or brush marks. The green sprig has thick fleshy toy-like leaves, flower is a puffed vinyl blossom, book is an inflated stylised object, rays and squiggles are chunky soft tubing. Deliberately designed playful 3D icon objects with big readable volumes rather than realistic photographs. White background, controlled studio lighting upper left. Do not add human-like facial traits or extra eyes.

directions.name: Q — Painted wooden toys
directions.style: RENDERING Q: handcrafted carved and painted WOOD. All six forms are thick wooden silhouettes with softly chamfered imperfect cut edges, slight carved gouges, fine visible natural wood grain beneath matte coloured paint, and a few honest exposed cream wood edges. Preserve exact base colours, not an all-brown wood set. The kite is a carved diamond with four painted panels and a dark wooden or cord-like looping string; leaves and petals are carved broad shapes with incised veins; book is a little hinged carved form; sun has separate wood rays; squiggle and pebbles are smoothly sanded wooden pieces. An artful contemporary wooden playroom illustration system. Soft realistic shadows and believable material, quiet premium craft, no plastic, felt, clay, metallic shine, or printed distressed-paper grain.

directions.name: R — Glazed ceramics
directions.style: RENDERING R: small hand-built GLAZED CERAMIC sculptures, kiln-fired terracotta shapes covered in glossy opaque brand-colour glazes. Rounded slab construction with subtly wobbly edges, slight glaze pooling at curves and tiny irregular ceramic speckles, clean bright reflected highlights distinct from satin vinyl, occasional thin cream clay edge. The sprig and flower look like clay botanical reliefs, the kite and book like shaped glazed relief tiles with softly raised details, sun and squiggle are thick hand-formed shiny ceramic pieces. Restrained dimensionality and white studio ground, soft contact shadows, believable artisan ceramic material. Colour stays saturated, not pastel beige pottery, not porcelain figurine kitsch. No crackle overload, no decorative patterns, no text or plates behind objects.

Keep EXACT same object identities, colours, silhouettes, layout and two sun strokes from A while increasing natural material observation. Warm skilled picture-book rendering with dimensional depth and fine botanical care echoing reference 3. White background. NO photoreal cutout stock images, no outlines around everything, no 3D plastic, no cartoon people, no scenery.

directions.name: T — Graphic relief
directions.style: RENDERING T: crisp contemporary 2.5D GRAPHIC RELIEF. Start with the flat gently imperfect shapes from reference 1 and reference 2, then give each only a shallow uniform extrusion. Large flat front colour faces remain completely untextured and graphic; side faces are one clearly darker flat shade; depth revealed through sharp but rounded edges and one crisp soft-edged offset shadow. No smooth bulbous shading or gradients across front faces, no realistic material or glossy lighting, no bevelled app-icon buttons. The kite has shallow raised panel shapes, leaves and flower shallow layered planes, book constructed from a few offset curved slabs, sun a flat thick disc and separate slab rays, squiggle a shallow extruded ribbon with flat pebble planes. Punchy silhouette-first dimensional vector illustration, playful rounded geometry, front-facing with small consistent view of right/bottom side faces. This must read distinctly as graphic illustration with depth rather than a photo of real objects.
